col.name: Name
plan.fallback: {want} is out of stock, using the next choice
plan.no_keys: none: DigitalOcean will email a root password and password login stays on
plan.no_timer: none: it keeps billing until you delete it
plan.cost_ttl: about {ttl} if it lives until the timer, {month} for a full month
up.big_confirm: This batch costs {total}/month, over your {limit} limit. Type the number of droplets to continue
up.waiting: Waiting for droplets to answer on port {port}...
up.password: Login password for {user}: {pw}  (shown once, change it after first login)
up.expiry_note: Timer set: `dofleet reap` deletes these after {ttl}. Run it from cron, or use `dofleet extend` to keep them longer.
ls.total: {n} droplet(s), {month} per month, about {spent} spent so far
down.confirm: Delete {n} droplet(s)? This cannot be undone
extend.kept: {name}: timer removed, it will run until you delete it
cost.no_timer: {n} droplet(s) have no expiry timer. `dofleet ls` shows which.
presets.where: Add or change presets in {path} (run `dofleet init` to create it).
init.done: Wrote {path}. Edit it, then run `dofleet whoami` to test your token.
menu.name: Name or prefix
warn.config_perms: {path} holds a token and other users can read it. Run: chmod 600 {path}
err.need_yes: Not a terminal: add --yes to confirm.
err.no_token: No API token for profile '{profile}'. Set one of: {envs}, or add token to config.toml. Create a token at https://cloud.digitalocean.com/account/api/tokens
err.no_ssh_key: No SSH key named '{name}' on this account.
err.sold_out: Nothing in stock for regions [{regions}] and sizes [{sizes}]. Try `dofleet sizes -r <region>` or add more fallbacks to the preset.
err.no_template: No setup template '{name}'. Bundled: {known}, or give a file path.
err.bad_var: Template value '{name}' may only contain letters, digits and . _ @ : / + = -
err.user_data_size: Setup script is {size} bytes; DigitalOcean allows 65536.
err.no_ip: That droplet has no public IPv4 yet.
err.no_ssh: No `ssh` command found on this machine.
err.api_401: DigitalOcean rejected the token (401). Check it, or run `dofleet whoami`.
err.api_403: The token is not allowed to do this (403). It may be read-only.
err.api_429: DigitalOcean rate limit hit (429). Wait a minute and try again.
err.duration: '{text}' is not a duration. Use a number with m, h, d or w, like 30m or 2h.
